prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object close, take it. If object heavy, move it. Finally, do specific task or move closer. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDestination    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDestination
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
